Name: Customers order online
Goal: A customer can sign in, build or repeat an order and get a confirmation.
PreviewPoint: A customer signs in on a phone, repeats last week's order and receives the confirmation email.

Name: Order desk and ERP
Goal: The order desk handles changes and every order reaches the ERP.
PreviewPoint: The order desk changes an order before 18:00 and the 18:30 CSV export contains it.

Name: Delivery status
Goal: Customers follow their orders until delivery.
PreviewPoint: A customer follows an order from received to delivered.
